hardware_component_candidate.type: high-speed low-voltage comparator with known output state in POR
hardware_component_candidate.features_confirmed: 1.8-5.5V operating, approx 40ns typical comparator propagation, POR initially low, SC70-5
hardware_component_candidate.recommended_function: primary CT conditioning and hard-trip comparator; configure comparator output HIGH only if CT signal safely below threshold AND its local 5V power is in range
hardware_component_candidate.limits: CT burden may exceed comparator rails at faults; add explicit attenuation/clamp/series impedance + reference accuracy; POR low may last up to 32us; 40ns typical not a worst-case trip bound

tiers.name: ALWAYS_ACTIVE_HARD_TRIP
tiers.active: whenever power stage is eligible to run, including cold start
tiers.trip_source: independent conditioned CT, sensor integrity, comparator PGOOD, primary and secondary bias health
tiers.rationale: No masking may leave a short during soft start unprotected

tiers.name: FAST_OPTIMIZATION_TRIP
tiers.active: only after explicitly confirmed stable soft-start state
tiers.rationale: PROT-B unarmed 1.8V trial latched during startup; need tuned min/max thresholds

tiers.name: FAIL_SAFE_DEFAULT
tiers.trip_source: power-on asserted hardware latch with explicit acknowledge after healthy power
tiers.rationale: Do not rely on UCC24624 standby or independent controller reset alone

logic_start_state: LATCHED_OFF until all rails and monitor valid AND manual reset/ack with all 10 gates low
soft_start_rule: hard_trip unconditionally overrides reset and early-arming; fast_trip is optional only while armed
rearm_rule: manual reset only if all good, no active trip, start sequence ready and all ten gates confirmed off
physical_output_rule: primary U2.EN LOW and all 8 SR external EN LOW (TI buffered candidate) or TRIG HIGH (onsemi native alternative), independent bias and communication fault handling required
design_missing: Sensor CT open/short detection threshold and independent test
12V->5V comparator supply/analog attenuation and input clamp
Hardware latch with set priority, asynchronous POR and manual reset
Independent fail-low primary RUN and eight SR inhibits; propagation/UVLO waveforms
Isolated signal transfer if any primary and secondary domain separation
Actual primary gate turn-off and 8x SR gate/off time verification
No interposer testing or real logic assembled
